01 Antidepressants · class card

Other antidepressants

atypical antidepressants · bupropion · mirtazapine · trazodone · vilazodone · vortioxetine

Key point
  • Bupropion lowers the seizure threshold avoid it with a seizure disorder, bulimia or anorexia, or an abrupt stop of alcohol, a benzodiazepine, a barbiturate or an antiepileptic
  • Trazodone blocks alpha-1 receptors priapism and orthostatic hypotension; an erection over 4 hours is a urologic emergency
  • Mirtazapine sedates and raises appetite and weight; it and bupropion cause no sexual dysfunction
Drugs

Bupropion Wellbutrin SR (sustained release), XL (extended release): norepinephrine and dopamine reuptake inhibitor

Mirtazapine Remeron: alpha-2 antagonist

Trazodone: serotonin 2 antagonist, used mostly for sleep

Vilazodone Viibryd: serotonin 1A partial agonist Vilazodone labelViibryd is taken with food; diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and insomnia are its most common effects. With a strong cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) inhibitor, its dose stays at 20 mg a day or less.

Vortioxetine Trintellix: serotonin 1A agonist

Mechanism

Bupropion: norepinephrine and dopamine reuptake blocked mild stimulant; seizure threshold lowered

Mirtazapine: alpha-2 autoreceptor blocked more serotonin and norepinephrine released; histamine H1 blocked sedation, appetite Serotonin receptorsMirtazapine also blocks serotonin 2 and 3 receptors, so serotonergic and noradrenergic function rise without sexual dysfunction or nausea.

Trazodone: serotonin 2 blocked, weak serotonin reuptake block; alpha-1 blocked vasodilation orthostatic hypotension, priapism; H1 blocked sedation

Uses

Bupropion: depression with fatigue or hypersomnia, concern about weight gain, or a wish to quit smoking

Mirtazapine: depression with insomnia or weight loss; older adults

Trazodone: mainly insomnia (off label), at low doses; sedation limits antidepressant doses

Adverse effects

Bupropion: insomnia, fast pulse; seizures, dose-related (below); less weight gain; no sexual dysfunction, and it may relieve it Bupropion labelThe Wellbutrin XL label adds dry mouth and raised blood pressure; check blood pressure before starting and during treatment.

Mirtazapine: sedation, appetite and weight gain, raised cholesterol, dry mouth; no sexual dysfunction Mirtazapine labelThe Remeron label warns of agranulocytosis: with sore throat, fever, mouth sores or infection and a low white blood cell count, stop the drug.

Trazodone: sedation, orthostatic hypotension, priapism, sexual dysfunction; QT prolongation

Vortioxetine: sexual dysfunction, abnormal dreams

Other

Urine drug screen: bupropion can give a false positive for amphetamines Confirming the screenThe Wellbutrin XL label: a confirmatory test (gas chromatography with mass spectrometry) tells bupropion from amphetamines.

Bupropion seizuresRisk climbs with the dose and with fast dose increases; electrolyte abnormalities, as in bulimia or anorexia, raise it further

If there is a seizure disorder, bulimia or anorexia, or an abrupt stop of alcohol, a benzodiazepine, a barbiturate or an antiepileptic, choose another antidepressant, such as a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI).

A seizure on bupropion: stop it and never restart it

Ischemic priapismAn erection lasting over 4 hours on trazodone, usually painful, from alpha-1 block; sildenafil and sickle cell disease are other causes

If an erection lasts over 4 hours on trazodone, choose corporal aspiration or intracavernosal phenylephrine. How it worksAn alpha-1 agonist constricts the helicine arterioles.

A urologic emergency: untreated, it may end in permanent erectile dysfunction or penile necrosis Trazodone labelThe trazodone label: with an erection past 4 hours, painful or not, stop the drug and seek emergency care at once.

Interactions, by result
Combined withResultRule
A monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), or one stopped inside its washout Bupropion: hypertensive reaction; mirtazapine, trazodone: serotonin syndromeNever together
Linezolid, a weak MAOISerotonin syndrome In practiceStep 2 names serotonin toxicity, with bupropion too. The bupropion label instead bars starting it on linezolid for hypertensive reactions; the mirtazapine label bars it as well.Avoid
Drugs cleared by cytochrome P450 2D6 (CYP2D6), eg, nortriptyline, paroxetine, metoprolol, flecainideTheir levels rise on bupropionConsider a lower dose

Practice
  1. 23-year-old woman with depression asks for an antidepressant binges and vomits several times a week; wants to quit smoking worried about weight gain on other drugs potassium 3.1 mEq/L · chloride 92 mEq/L → Bupropion → bupropion is contraindicated in bulimia and anorexia because it lowers the seizure threshold and purging disturbs electrolytes; SSRIs remain first-line antidepressants
  2. 38-year-old man with a painful erection lasting 6 hours began a sedating antidepressant at bedtime 2 weeks ago no sickle cell disease; no injected erectile drugs BP 118/76 mm Hg · HR 88/min → Trazodone → trazodone blocks alpha-1 receptors and can cause priapism; bupropion causes insomnia and no sexual dysfunction, and mirtazapine sedates and raises appetite without sexual dysfunction
  3. 78-year-old woman with depression, poor sleep and weight loss starts mirtazapine at bedtime no seizures, eating disorder or heart disease weight 48 kg, down 4 kg · BP 128/74 mm Hg → Increased appetite and weight gain → mirtazapine blocks histamine H1 receptors, so it sedates and raises appetite and weight, welcome here; insomnia belongs to bupropion, and mirtazapine causes no sexual dysfunction
